title: Vallée says there are protocols for leaving the cave

tellings.quote: And I asked Jacques Valle this. I said, "Are there protocols?" And he said, he's like, "Yes, there are."

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have confirmed that there are protocols, meaning set methods, for leaving "the cave", which is Plato's image of people chained in a cave who take shadows on the wall for reality. Michels tells this himself in a conversation about consciousness: he says he asked Vallée "Are there protocols?" and Vallée answered, "Yes, there are." Michels does not say what the protocols are, but he tells it as a sign that someone thinks there is a practical way to see past ordinary reality.
